detail.longDescription:
Plan your day, timebox your focus, and ship more - without telemetry, accounts, or paywalls.

Super Productivity is an open-source task manager and time tracker built for developers, freelancers, and anyone who wants deep work without distractions. 51,000+ Google Play downloads and 18,000+ GitHub stargazers. How-To Geek called it "most comprehensive Pomodoro timer functionality" among free apps.

What's inside:
- Timeboxing + daily planner: drag tasks onto your schedule, commit to blocks of focused work.
- Pomodoro timer with break reminders and a procrastination helper built on CBT techniques.
- One-click time tracking with automatic timesheets and CSV/JSON export.
- Native sync with Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Redmine, OpenProject, Linear, ClickUp, Azure DevOps, and Trello.
- Kanban, Eisenhower Matrix, daily planner, and compact list layouts - pick what fits your brain.
- Notes, file attachments, and bookmarks attached to any task.

Privacy is not a setting:
- No data collection, ever. No analytics, no telemetry.
- No account required. Your tasks never leave your device unless you set up sync.
- Optional sync via WebDAV, Dropbox, or CalDAV - your storage, your choice.

In active development since 2016, with 19,400+ commits and a global community of contributors. Featured by Lifehacker, How-To Geek, Android Police, It's FOSS, OMG! Ubuntu!, and XDA Developers. MIT-licensed and free forever - no premium tier, no ads, no paid modules.

If you've bounced between Todoist, TickTick, Notion, and Toggl looking for something that respects your attention and your data, try Super Productivity.
